event: MSCI issued a statement in Singapore denying reports that it had told the Indonesian government it would not downgrade Indonesia's market status, saying the proposal to move Indonesia from Emerging Market to Standalone Market still stands. (update of E1068)

event: The rupiah closed 0.15% weaker at Rp18,230 per US dollar on 24 November as the dollar index stayed firm. (update of E1069)

event: Danantara is due to present its first public consolidated financial report, for fiscal 2025 covering BUMN under its management, on Wednesday 25 November after receiving the BPK audit, moved from the earlier 23 November target. (update of E0862)
key_numbers: Report date 25 Nov 2026 (earlier target 23 Nov) · covers Feb-Dec 2025 (Danantara launched Feb 2025) · full report to be shared publicly · no figures disclosed yet

event: BP BUMN head Dony Oskaria said BUMN undergoing restructuring get a three-year income tax (PPh) exemption that already applies, with the implementing regulation to follow.

event: Pertamina's business transformation director Agung Wicaksono said the company will finish restructuring 84 of its subsidiaries by end-2026, with 46 already done and 20 (including Pelita Air) carrying over to 2027.
key_numbers: Pertamina 257 entities (about 25% of 1,041 BUMN entities in Danantara ecosystem) · target to restructure 104, leaving 153 · 46 done + 38 more by year-end = 84 · 20 carry over to 2027 · layers cut from 7 to 3

event: Nvidia shares jumped about 31% after its board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, then fell roughly 7-9% intraday on 24 November as the US tech rally faded. (update of E0820)

event: US stocks fell on 24 November in a tech selloff, with the dollar index at its highest since March 2025, the 10-year Treasury yield near 5% and gold down over 2%.
key_numbers: Midday: Nasdaq -2.24% to 23,549 · S&P 500 -0.99% to 7,166 · Dow +0.24% to 49,715 · 10-year yield 4.92% · gold -2.29% to ~US$3,568 · Brent ~US$88 (sources inconsistent) vs US$92.57 on 20 Nov · US PCE inflation report due Wed 25 Nov

key_numbers: Hearing Thu 26 Nov 2026 · prior dismissals in related cases: Ahrie Sonta (10 Nov), Eko Hadi Santoso (17 Nov), Tedjo Kusumo (24 Nov)

event: Bareskrim said suspects in the makar case carried out a conspiracy (permufakatan) and attacks on social media; Dasco visited Prabowo at Istana Merdeka the same evening. (update of E1087)
